description: Fetch one public template at a pinned version. For example, pass {"path":{"id":"business-automation"},"query":{"version":1}}. Use a saved slug or ID and version from the same searchPublicSpecifications item. Only the currently published revision is available. A 404 calls for a new search. If a saved digest differs, stop and review the change before adopting the template.

path.description: Identifies the public template to retrieve.

id.description: A public template ID (rt_…) or slug such as business-automation. Both identify a template directly.

query.description: Pins the lookup to one published version.

version.description: Positive integer from the selected item or a saved version pin. An unavailable revision returns HTTP 404.

name: getPublicSpecification

data.description: The published result on success, or the upstream error payload.

httpStatus.description: Upstream HTTP status. A failed read also sets isError on the MCP result.

digest.description: Digest of the selected template revision.

slug.description: Human-readable identifier accepted for direct reads.

template.description: Published template, including scope and review criteria.
